regime_context: The detector shows AI Infrastructure as the clear momentum leader (rank 1, breadth 0.875, not crowded) with Semiconductor Equipment the closest challenger, under a narrowing rotation (43% of themes eligible). Trend discipline is genuinely risk-reducing on this market (gate_helps true), but my own lead-direction record is weak (dir_accuracy 0.488 over 84 calls), so I lean low.
emerging_watch: Watching whether AI Infrastructure's durability_bar (0.73) rises above 0.85 while keeping breadth above 0.8 — that would mark a strengthening, broad-based leader I'd upgrade to medium conviction; if instead its durability falls below challenger WFE's 0.80 with margin closing under 0.3, the watch retires and I treat leadership as contested.

theses.subject: AI Infrastructure
theses.thesis: Top-ranked momentum with high breadth (0.875) and a durability bar (0.73) that is above the challenger for cohesion; the absolute-trend gate is eligible and historically cuts drawdown/volatility on this market, so the staying-power leg supports holding the leader rather than chasing challengers. Crowding is not flagged, so no sizing caution. This is a persistence lean on the confirmed leader, not a prediction of new highs.
theses.dissent: The leader's own hurst_tag is 'mixed' (not clean trend), and cross-sectional momentum rank has ~0 IC, so leadership concentration may simply be late-stage attention rather than durable trend; mean-reversion to the broader tech complex could unwind the premium.

falsifier.text: SMH undercuts its 50-day average by more than one ATR, or AI Infrastructure drops below rank 3 on this detector's score, before the 30-day check-by date

theses.subject: Cybersecurity
theses.thesis: Cybersecurity shows strong momentum and perfect breadth (1.0) with a high durability bar (0.81), but crowding_z of 1.91 is the most stretched crowding flag in the eligible set. Per guardrails, crowding is a size-down caution, never a fade or short — but for a fresh lean it argues against initiating new exposure here; the risk/reward is skewed by reflexivity into an attention-crowded, fully-participated theme.
theses.dissent: Crowding has no validated basket-level forward drawdown edge, and perfect breadth with high durability can persist far longer than crowding skeptics expect; refusing exposure to a confirmed trend leader is itself a cost.

falsifier.text: CIBR holds above its 20-day average and crowding_z stays above 1.5 with no drawdown through the 20-day check-by date

theses.subject: Memory, HBM & Storage
theses.thesis: Cleanest trend signature in the top echelon (hurst_tag 'trend', the only leader-class theme with that tag) and well under the crowding threshold (z 0.22). Breadth is moderate (0.5) and durability moderate (0.66), but the absolute-trend gate is eligible and this theme is not showing the reflexivity risk that afflicts Cybersecurity. A modest persistence lean within the semiconductor complex, framed as a lower-crowding alternative to WFE.
theses.dissent: Breadth of only 0.5 suggests the trend is concentrated in a subset of names (likely the HBM leaders), so the theme can look trending on the ETF proxy while underlying participation is weak; a single-name earnings miss in the HBM complex could crack the whole theme.

falsifier.text: SMH (the proxy) halves its 10-day relative gain versus SPY, or Memory drops out of the top 10 in rank, before the 40-day check-by date

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
